tests.name: Homepage loads
tests.instruction: Verify the page has a visible heading and body content.

tests.name: Button is present
tests.instruction: Verify at least one button is visible on the page.

tests.name: Form exists
tests.instruction: Verify a form with an input field is present.

tests.name: Page is mobile responsive
tests.instruction: Check that the page layout does not overflow horizontally at 375px viewport width.

tests.name: Navigation to Github
tests.instruction: Check that the page has link or button to navigate to github.com.
